stem: Voltmarkt changes how its app's home screen lists saved items, a feature regular users open every day. Which test plan is the safer one?

options.text: One week, since a randomised test shows the long-run effect straight away
Several weeks, with the effect checked by week and for new versus returning users
One day, since habits show up on a user's first visit after the change
Until the result first reaches p < 0.05, then stop and ship the winner
